definitions.explanation: Being in favor of something; agreeing with a proposal or opinion.

examples.japanese: {賛成|さんせい}{多数|たすう}で{可決|かけつ}された。
examples.english: It was passed by a majority vote.

examples.japanese: その{意見|いけん}に{賛成|さんせい}です。
{会議|かいぎ}では{賛成|さんせい}と{反対|はんたい}の{意見|いけん}が{半々|はんはん}に{分|わ}かれた。
examples.english: At the meeting, opinions for and against were split evenly.

notes:
{賛成|さんせい} expresses agreement or approval.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {賛成|さんせい}する (to agree)
- 〜に{賛成|さんせい}だ (agree with ~)
- {賛成|さんせい}{多数|たすう} (majority in favor)
- {賛成|さんせい}{派|は} (supporters, pro-faction)

ANTONYM:
- {反対|はんたい} (opposition, against)

VOTING:
- {賛成|さんせい}! (Aye!)
- {反対|はんたい}! (Nay!)
